project_name: JobPilot - ERP for Job Seekers (Saudi Arabia & GCC Focus)
theme_strategy: Calm, focused, dense tactical productivity tool. Soft slate/sand base with deep forest emerald primary accents and electric amber score indicators.

bilingual_rtl_strategy.direction_mode: Fully mirrored dir='rtl' when Arabic is active. Sidebar switches to right side, flex layout directions flip, icons mirror where directional (arrows, chevrons, flow indicators), Kanban columns reverse (Saved starts on right in RTL).
bilingual_rtl_strategy.font_loading_instructions: Import Google Fonts: Work Sans (400, 500, 600, 700) and Cairo (400, 600, 700) in index.html or index.css. Apply font-family dynamically based on active locale.

colors.archetype: Organic & Performance Pro Hybrid (Grounded Forest Emerald + Precision Tactical Amber)

grids_and_layouts.app_shell: Responsive sidebar layout with top bar tenant switcher, quick search trigger, language switcher (EN/AR), theme toggle, notification center, and user avatar menu.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_bento: High Density Grid (MODE B). 4-column base. Hero KPI summary banner span 4, Funnel chart span 2, Weekly goals/upcoming reminders span 2, Recent match feed span 4.
grids_and_layouts.kanban_tracker: 7-stage workflow columns (Saved -> Preparing -> Applied -> Interview -> Offer -> Rejected -> Ghosted). Horizontal scrollable container with touch drag/card count badges and quick add button.
grids_and_layouts.tailor_studio_diff: 2-column side-by-side split screen view with sync-scrolling option, highlight diffs (Green addition, Red removal/caution, Yellow AI suggestion), top bar approval actions & hallucination checker badge.

key_components_and_interactions.app_shell_sidebar: Collapsible sidebar with icon + label links, active route highlight with subtle emerald left-border bar in LTR (right-border bar in RTL).
key_components_and_interactions.job_card: Includes company logo, job title, location tag, salary tag, source (LinkedIn, Bayt, Tanqeeb, GulfTalent, Direct), AI Match Score pill with match ring, and Verdict button.
key_components_and_interactions.ai_review_panel: Side panel or tab showing Matched Skills tags (green), Missing Skills tags (orange), Red Flags warning boxes, and concise bullet AI rationale.
key_components_and_interactions.tailor_studio: Side-by-side CV comparison with real-time toggle between 'Master CV' and 'Tailored Version'. Diff viewer highlights added keywords and modified phrasing.
key_components_and_interactions.validation_check_box: Hallucination warning pill: verifies dates, company names, and metric claims against Master CV before export.
key_components_and_interactions.kanban_card: Draggable or menu-selectable application card with status, last activity date, salary indicator, notes counter, and next action reminder tag.
key_components_and_interactions.reminders_sheet: Timezone aware reminder creator with quiet hours indicator, quick templates ('Follow up post-interview', 'Check application status').
key_components_and_interactions.stripe_billing_meters: Usage progress bars showing AI tailored CVs used (e.g., 14/20 used) and Job scans remaining.

instructions_to_main_agent: Always wrap root application or layout in a direction controller (<div dir={isRtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'} className={isRtl ? 'font-arabic' : 'font-sans'}>).
Ensure every clickable button, form field, tab, card, and interactive element contains a clear 'data-testid' attribute (e.g. data-testid='apply-verdict-button').
DO NOT use generic centered text for content panels. Left-align text in LTR and Right-align text in RTL.
Use Radix/Shadcn UI components (Select, Dialog, Drawer, Tabs, DropdownMenu, Switch, Tooltip, Table) with explicit non-transparent background colors.
Support full bilingual state switching across all views: Landing page, Onboarding wizard, Job Feed, Tailor Studio, Kanban Board, Reminders, Settings, Billing, and Admin panel.
